message.content:
Based on a meticulous review of the "Zones & metrics" card, here are the measurable visual defects:

1.  **Truncated/Clipped Data in Time Column (Z1):** In the row for **Z1 Endurance**, the time value is rendered as a single, clipped vertical bar (`|`) instead of the full `0:00` text seen in other rows.
2.  **Truncated/Clipped Data in Time Column (Z5):** In the row for **Z5 Anaerobic**, the time value is also rendered as a single, clipped vertical bar (`|`) instead of the full `0:00` text.
3.  **Misaligned/Overlapping Text (Z1):** The clipped vertical bar character in the Z1 Time column is misaligned vertically, sitting noticeably higher than the baseline of the text in the adjacent Range and Share columns.
4.  **Misaligned/Overlapping Text (Z5):** Similarly, the clipped vertical bar character in the Z5 Time column is misaligned vertically, sitting higher than the text baseline in its row.
